candidates.change_summary: Change the airdrop credit from 20 to 40 tokens so tokenBalance ends higher than in the original.
Remove the supportsToken check so callers other than the Bank contract (any msg.sender) can successfully call airDrop and receive 20 tokens where the original reverts.
Remove the hasNoBalance check so an address with a nonzero balance can call airDrop again, raising its balance from 20 to 40 (original reverts).
Changed the airdrop amount credited from 20 to 21 tokens.
Deleted the statement that resets _locked to false after the function body, so the lock is never released.
Inverted the hasNoBalance check so it requires a non-zero balance instead of a zero balance.
Changed the string hashed in the supportsToken check so the comparison always fails and airDrop always reverts.
Change the airdrop credit from +20 to +21 tokens.
Delete the statement that credits 20 tokens to the caller.
Delete the unlock statement so the lock is never cleared, causing every airDrop call after the first to revert.
Invert the hasNoBalance check so it requires a nonzero balance instead of zero.
Compare against a different token-name hash so the supportsToken check always fails and airDrop reverts.
Delete the balance update statement so airDrop no longer credits tokens.
Credit 19 tokens instead of 20 so the resulting balance differs.
Set _locked to false instead of true, allowing a reentrant airDrop call during the supportsToken external call to succeed and double the credited balance.
Require an existing balance of 1 instead of 0 so legitimate airdrop calls revert.
Hash a different string so the supportsToken check fails and airDrop always reverts.
